apihelp-eqldrops-summary: Read repeated corpse-loot report aggregates. Percentages describe reported loot, not drop chance. Private event and contributor identifiers are never returned.
apihelp-eqldrops-param-zone: Exact reported zone or zone title.
apihelp-eqldrops-param-npc: Exact reported NPC or NPC title.
apihelp-eqldrops-param-item: Exact reported item or item title.
apihelp-eqldrops-param-instance: Filter normal, raid or unknown instance reports.
apihelp-eqldrops-param-q: Literal text search across zone, NPC, item and server.
apihelp-eqldrops-param-offset: Number of aggregate entries to skip.
apihelp-eqldrops-param-limit: Number of aggregate entries (1–500), or individual submissions for one expanded entry (1–50).
apihelp-eqldrops-param-detail: Opaque entry ID from a currently published aggregate; request a bounded page of its individual submissions.
apihelp-eqldrops-param-snapshot: Snapshot token from the same aggregate response. Required for submission detail; stale tokens must be refreshed.
apierror-eqldrops-detail-stale: These submissions changed. Reload the drop database and expand the current entry.
apierror-eqldrops-detail-unavailable: This submission history is unavailable. Please refresh the drop database.
apierror-eqldrops-unavailable: The drop database is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
apierror-eqldrops-invalid: Use valid drop database filters and pagination values.
grant-eozobservations: Submit attributed gameplay observations (does not edit pages)
apihelp-eozobservations-summary: Store attributed, data-only kill and loot observations. Article creation and editing use the standard edit API. See API Documentation.
apihelp-eozobservations-param-operation: Check authenticated capability or submit an idempotent observation batch.
apihelp-eozobservations-param-batch: JSON schemaVersion 1 batch; at most 100 events and 262144 UTF-8 bytes per request. Send further batches to drain the backlog. Optional characterName requires explicit public-attribution consent. See API_Documentation.
apihelp-eqlmetadata-summary: Read batched revision-aware EQL era metadata. See API Documentation for page, image and contribution workflows.
apihelp-eqlplayers-summary: Read player-reported character snapshots from currently public User pages using Character sheet schema 1.
apihelp-eqlcharactereffects-summary: Read current public item effects to fill missing effect metadata in existing character sheets. No item or character statistics are returned or changed.
apihelp-eqlcharactereffects-param-titles: Pipe-separated canonical main-namespace item titles, at most 50 per request.
apierror-eqlcharactereffects-limit: Request at most 50 item titles in one effect lookup.
apihelp-eqlplayers-param-limit: Maximum User pages examined in this batch (1–25). Follow continuation even when a batch contains no players.
apihelp-eqlplayers-param-continue: Opaque continuation returned by the preceding batch.
apihelp-eqlplayers-param-detail: Exact player ID from the directory. Fetch one bounded public equipment snapshot only when expanded.
apihelp-eqlplayers-param-snapshot: Snapshot token from the same directory row; page or template changes invalidate it.
apierror-eqlplayers-detail-invalid: Use the player ID and snapshot token from the same public directory row.
apierror-eqlplayers-detail-stale: This public snapshot changed. Refresh the directory before requesting its details.
apierror-eqlplayers-detail-conflict: This profile contains conflicting copies of the same character snapshot. View the profile for details.
apierror-eqlplayers-detail-unavailable: This character's public equipment snapshot is unavailable. Please retry or view the profile.
apierror-eqlplayers-unavailable: The public player list cannot be verified completely right now. Please retry.
apihelp-eqlmetadata-param-titles: Pipe-separated wiki titles; at most the configured title limit (normally 500).
apierror-eoz-login: Log in with a named wiki account before sending observations.
apierror-eoz-blocked: This wiki account cannot send observations while blocked.
apierror-eoz-email: Confirm your wiki email before sending observations.
apierror-eoz-disabled: This wiki is not accepting Eye of Zomm observations.
apierror-eoz-schema: Eye of Zomm observation storage has not been activated.
apierror-eoz-schema-unavailable: Eye of Zomm observation storage has not been activated.
apierror-eoz-invalid: The observation batch contains unsupported or invalid data.
apierror-eoz-rate-limit: The observation upload limit was reached. Keep the local batch and retry later.
apierror-eoz-capacity: Observation storage is full. Keep pending data locally until the wiki operator resolves capacity.
apierror-eoz-batch-conflict: This observation batch ID already belongs to different content. Review the pending batch.
